era: Arcade / Dreamcast / PSP / Xbox 360 / PlayStation 3 / Wii / Mobile
summary: Sega AM3/Hitmaker/Sumo Digital's arcade tennis series; use Dreamcast for the NAOMI-era home entries, Xbox 360 for VT3/2009, PS3 plus Vita secondary for VT4, and Android/iOS preservation for Challenge.

emulation.notes: Use Dreamcast for campaign content; arcade preservation only for cabinet comparison.

primary.why: The arcade original was expanded for home play with campaign mode, and the Dreamcast shares the NAOMI-era hardware lineage while providing the complete home feature set.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Dreamcast hardware or Flycast with VGA/upscaled output; use arcade only for original cabinet comparison.

entries.title: Virtua Tennis 4
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 3 primary plus Vita World Tour Edition for handheld exclusives

emulation.emulator: PS3 hardware / RPCS3 if compatible; Vita hardware for secondary
emulation.notes: Use PS3 for the main run and Vita hardware for the exclusive feature check.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native HD-console output plus Vita feature preservation

primary.why: VT4 released on PS3, Xbox 360, Wii, Windows, Vita, and arcade. The PS3 version has stereoscopic 3D, PlayStation Move support, and sourced exclusive legends/mini-games, making it the most complete HD-console primary; the Vita World Tour Edition has separate handheld-exclusive features.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 version on original hardware or RPCS3 if compatible; use Vita/World Tour Edition only for its exclusive handheld features.

secondary.exclusive_content: World Tour Edition adds touch/gyro/camera/AR features, same-system two-player play, templates, and social/stat-sharing features.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Vita-specific modes and feature set rather than replaying the whole game.
secondary.why: These features are exclusive to the Vita route and absent from the PS3 primary.

all_releases.fidelity: HD-console release with PlayStation Move, stereoscopic 3D, and PS3-exclusive legends/mini-games.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete sourced HD-console route.

all_releases.fidelity: HD-console release with Kinect support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong alternate, but lacks the sourced PS3-exclusive content.

all_releases.fidelity: Wii release with Wii MotionPlus support required for full motion controls.
all_releases.reason: skip: motion-control alternate with lower fidelity than HD-console routes.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release by Devil's Details.
all_releases.reason: skip: high-output route, but lacks sourced PS3-exclusive legends/mini-games.

all_releases.fidelity: Sega RingEdge arcade release after the console launch.
all_releases.reason: skip: arcade route, but not the most complete home feature set.

all_releases.fidelity: Virtua Tennis 4: World Tour Edition with Vita-exclusive camera, touch, gyro, AR, and same-system two-player features.
all_releases.reason: secondary: play only for the handheld-exclusive feature set.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS3 has exclusive HD-console content; Vita has separate handheld-exclusive features worth sampling secondarily.

entries.title: Virtua Tennis Challenge

emulation.notes: Use preserved compatible installs only where available.

primary.version: Original Android release / Sega Forever preservation if already owned
primary.why: Challenge launched first on Android and then iOS, later becoming part of Sega Forever; it was unlisted from app stores in mid-2025, so the practical route is preserved installs/offline play.
primary.how_to_play: Play only if already downloaded or preserved on a compatible Android/iOS device; no current storefront route is documented.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Android release, later Sega Forever mobile route before delisting.
all_releases.reason: primary: first release and selected mobile preservation route.

all_releases.fidelity: iOS release, later affected by app-store unlisting.
all_releases.reason: skip: comparable mobile alternate, but Android is selected as primary to keep one route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: App-store delisting makes preservation/access the main conflict.

entries.remaster_caveats: Unlisted from app stores in mid-2025; offline play remains only for prior downloads.
